text.en: Pet parents frequently commend the staff for their warm welcomes, professionalism, and generous attention toward puppies and active dogs. Clients appreciate that attendants spend time bonding with pets and maintaining a safe environment. Although one reviewer reported poor professionalism regarding grooming fees, the general consensus praises an attentive team.

title.en: Safe social environment for active dogs

text.en: Dog owners note that puppies and adult dogs enjoy interacting with regular playmates and attendants during daycare sessions. Multiple reviews highlight that dogs return home exhausted, happy, and uninjured, with separate playrooms helping ensure dogs are grouped with compatible companions based on temperament and size.

title.en: Frequent photo updates and webcam visibility

text.en: Most customers value the communication provided by the facility, pointing out prompt email replies, live webcam access to playrooms, and cute end-of-day report cards with pictures. On the other hand, one customer expressed frustration over a lack of prior explanation regarding special handling fees added to a grooming bill.

q.en: Can owners monitor their dogs during daycare?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm having access to live webcam footage of the playrooms alongside email updates and photo report cards.

q.en: What requirements must dogs meet before attending daycare?

a.en: Dogs must be up to date on required vaccinations and undergo an initial onboarding evaluation.

q.en: Are dogs separated into different play groups?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that the facility maintains multiple rooms so dogs are grouped with compatible playmates.

q.en: Does the facility offer grooming alongside daycare and boarding?

a.en: Yes, full grooming and spa services are offered, though client experiences reflect mixed satisfaction with styling.
